original.independentSamplerClockCaveat: Relative to sampler start, not exactly the recording origin; no original realtime/monotonic anchor was saved. Do not use its per-process CPU percentages during long scans: timestamps bracket different moments. Node process.cpuUsage deltas are directly usable.

clean-30-minute.nativeEndSampleScope: Nearest one-second native snapshot by delivered video count; full nativeFinal additionally includes startup/finalization and short post-workload sync decoding.

controlled-node-stall.nativeEndSampleScope: Nearest one-second native snapshot by delivered video count; full nativeFinal additionally includes startup/finalization and short post-workload sync decoding.
